import CategoryTheory.Limits
import Fintype

open CategoryTheory

theorem lg_target {G : Type v} [Group G] [Finite G] : 
  CategoryTheory.Limits.PreservesColimitsOfShape (CategoryTheory.SingleObj G) FintypeCat.incl := by
  -- The functor from FinType to Group is the forgetful functor
  let F : FintypeCat ⥤ GroupCat :=
    { obj := λ X, (X → G),
      map := λ X Y f, GroupHom.map f,
      map_id' := by intro X; apply Functor.id_map_id,
      map_comp' := by intro X Y Z f g; apply Functor.id_map_comp }
  -- This functor preserves colimits of shape SingleObj G
  apply CategoryTheory.Limits.evaluation_preservesColimitsOfShape
    FintypeCat.incl
    F
    (GroupCat.of G)
